## Overview

Part of the [**Data Science Projects Collection**](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-) (Cambodia tour price prediction)—Predicts tour package pricing from historical travel-market data in Cambodia.

## Problem & Data

Tour operators and travelers need fair price expectations amid seasonal demand and package variability.

## Approach

Historical price ingestion, feature encoding (duration, destination, season), and regression-based forecasting.

## Technologies

Python · pandas · scikit-learn · Jupyter

## Outcomes

Estimated price ranges for tour products with interpretable drivers (seasonality, route, inclusions).
